service: You can use Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore to view and update data in a key value store resource. For more information, see Using CloudFront KeyValueStore in the Amazon CloudFront Developer Guide.

operations.DeleteKey: Deletes the key-value pair specified by the key.
operations.DescribeKeyValueStore: Returns metadata information about the key value store.
operations.PutKey: Creates a new key-value pair or replaces the value of an existing key.
operations.UpdateKeys: Puts or deletes multiple key-value pairs in a single, all-or-nothing operation.

DeleteKeyResponse.base: Metadata information about a key value store.

DescribeKeyValueStoreResponse.base: Metadata information about a key value store.

refs.DeleteKeyRequest$IfMatch: The current version (ETag) of the key value store that you are deleting keys from, which you can get by using the DescribeKeyValueStore API operation.
refs.DeleteKeyResponse$ETag: The current version identifier of the key value store after the successful delete.
refs.DescribeKeyValueStoreResponse$ETag: The version identifier for the current version of the key value store.
refs.PutKeyRequest$IfMatch: The current version (ETag) of the key value store that you are putting keys into, which you can get by using the DescribeKeyValueStore API operation.
refs.PutKeyResponse$ETag: The current version identifier of the key value store after the successful put.
refs.UpdateKeysRequest$IfMatch: The current version (ETag) of the key value store that you are updating keys of, which you can get by using the DescribeKeyValueStore API operation.
refs.UpdateKeysResponse$ETag: The current version identifier of the key value store after the successful update.

refs.DeleteKeyResponse$ItemCount: Number of key-value pairs in the key value store after the successful delete.
refs.DescribeKeyValueStoreResponse$ItemCount: Number of key-value pairs in the key value store.
refs.GetKeyResponse$ItemCount: Number of key-value pairs in the key value store.
refs.PutKeyResponse$ItemCount: Number of key-value pairs in the key value store after the successful put.
refs.UpdateKeysResponse$ItemCount: Number of key-value pairs in the key value store after the successful update.

refs.DeleteKeyRequestListItem$Key: The key of the key-value pair to be deleted.
refs.PutKeyRequestListItem$Key: The key of the key-value pair list item to put.

refs.DescribeKeyValueStoreRequest$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.
refs.DescribeKeyValueStoreResponse$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.
refs.GetKeyRequest$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.
refs.ListKeysRequest$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.
refs.PutKeyRequest$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.
refs.UpdateKeysRequest$KvsARN: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the key value store.

refs.ListKeysRequest$MaxResults: Maximum number of results that are returned per call. The default is 10 and maximum allowed page is 50.

refs.DeleteKeyResponse$TotalSizeInBytes: Total size of the key value store after the successful delete, in bytes.

refs.GetKeyResponse$TotalSizeInBytes: Total size of the key value store in bytes.

refs.UpdateKeysResponse$TotalSizeInBytes: Total size of the key value store after the successful update, in bytes.
